capabilities.title: Video-grounded multimodal reasoning: answer questions with evidence from video frames
capabilities.sourceEvidence: The current README describes agentic end-to-end video generation with director, screenwriter, producer, and generation roles, not a fine-grained video Q&A model.
capabilities.reason: ViMax requires GPU-accelerated video model inference; Nexus free/local invariant and no video intelligence lane currently.

capabilities.title: Fine-grained temporal reasoning: locate specific events within video timelines
capabilities.sourceEvidence: The current README describes generation workflows and does not substantiate long-video temporal grounding as an exposed product capability.
capabilities.reason: GPU-dependent model; excluded pending a local video model lane.

capabilities.title: Multimodal context fusion patterns: combine video, audio, and text signals for reasoning
capabilities.sourceEvidence: ViMax combines scripts, storyboards, character assets, audio, and generated video within an agentic creation workflow.
capabilities.reason: A multi-model video production pipeline is a separate media-authoring product and requires GPU/model dependencies outside the Nexus intelligence dashboard.
